142/2022 By The Annigeri P.S. For The Offences Punishable
U/S 323, 498A, 504, 506 And 34 Of Ipc.
 This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day, The
Court Made The Following:
 Order

Learned counsel for the petitioners filed a memo which reads as under:
"The undersigned counsel for petitioners most humbly submit that the police have filed charge sheet as such matter has become infructuous.
Hence petitioner intends to withdraw the petition with liberty to file fresh petition.
Hence this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to permit petitioner to withdraw this petition with liberty to file fresh petition in the interest of justice and equity."
2. In view of the memo, petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
